decisions.id: W84-a revert and re-tier E2 -> E3
decisions.summary: the grain gate in hem.py::_comb_dry_and_beans dropped so the fork band is laid at every grain (0010's fork triangle planted dry), built and REVERTED on the cohort; the row re-tiered E2 -> E3 in audit/overrides.json and ranking.json, its claim left as found
decisions.why: Re-measured this round: the kept patch (audit/reverted/wave84-fork-band-every-grain.patch) is the gate alone (`if grain < 1.0:` -> `if True:`), applied in a detached worktree at HEAD 46a50c54b against a second detached worktree at HEAD, make cohort N=21 SEED=12 JOBS=9 (seeds 12-32 and 901-906). Reference settlement clean both ways. HEAD 24/27, refused 20, 22, 906. Patched 21/27, refused 12, 20, 22, 28 (NoDryExit), 31 and 32 (water_rules farm_without_its_channel); 906 passes. That is m:wave84-fork-band-reverted exactly over the seeds run (40 and 43 lie outside the slice, not re-run). Under XIII a seed that passed and now fails is a regression, so the literal fix cannot ship as it stands. The spec's Edge Case 'a fix that changes many maps' gives the route: where making the failing maps pass takes more than the row's tier, the row takes that work's tier and its claim stays as found. The refusals sit in the lane web, the dry exit, the water rules, the groves and the seating, outside hem.py, so the work is a change across modules, E3 by FR-003. The row is re-ordered, not dropped: the GM's 'fix all of it ... from easiest to hardest' still reaches it in E3 order. Same ruling as waves 69, 74, 81 and 83; this row has not been reverted before, so no retaking rule binds this wave.

decisions.id: W84-b the DEVIATION alternative not taken
decisions.summary: the ranking's alternative (record the village and hamlet departure from 0010 as a DEVIATION on 0010's drawing page) declined; the row held for an implementation fix
decisions.why: Declining the alternative is declining a narrowing. Taking it would have bent the record to the implementation, the direction FR-004 sends through the exception path; the GM asked that the implementation match the research. Nothing in the plan writes DEVIATION for this row.

decisions.id: W84-c fork band depth stays in DEFERRED_ON_MEASURE
decisions.summary: the claim `hem.py::_comb_dry_and_beans#fork band depth` stays deferred in audit/scope.py because no kept hamlet draws the band
decisions.why: A consequence of W84-a, not a new choice. The entry exists because the band runs only at a city's grain and the GM's amendment 8 limits the feature to code that magistracies, country shrines and scripted hamlets actually execute (W65-4). The scope.py comment still says taking the 'fork band skipped on villages' row ends the entry, so the link survives the revert.

decisions.id: W84-d the failed fix recorded at the gate, code and pool as HEAD, no claim owed
decisions.summary: a comment at the grain gate records the fix that failed and its cohort; the patch is kept under audit/reverted/; the engine change is comment-only; T196/T197 close the wave with no impl-drift owed
decisions.why: Checked in the clone: git diff of hem.py is the four comment lines alone, so no code moved and no claim's text changed. Recording a failed fix at the point of change is constitution XIV's own requirement. Tasks Phase 85 carries the wave's two boxes as for waves 81 and 83.

decisions.id: W84-e the ranking row's fix text rewritten
decisions.summary: the row's fix text and files list replaced with the E3 note; the earlier text's two follow-ups (restate 0010's drawing page, which plants the band 'on a city map'; take `fork band depth` out of DEFERRED_ON_MEASURE) and their two files are no longer listed on the row
decisions.why: This does not narrow what the GM asked for. The row is still open and still owes its whole fix, and the DEFERRED_ON_MEASURE follow-up is still stated in audit/scope.py. Note for the session (not blocking): when the row is retaken, restore the drawing-page restatement and the scope.py exit to the row's fix text, or name them in that wave's plan. 0010's drawing page says the head of each field is dry 'on a city map', and a band laid at hamlet grain leaves that sentence incomplete.
